_meta.title: Backroom A+B retained cruising candidates — QA positions 36–40
_meta.methods: Read source archival per-candidate checks, original source pages or indexes when publicly accessible; cross-check independently mapped business/site details using current official operators and dated construction notices. No assertion all eight specialty sources have been live checked; paywalled/restricted information not equated to evidence of no activity.
_meta.disclaimer: 'Retain' refers only to the 92-item audit queue. It is not owner approval to publish, nor evidence of permission for sexual activity in a public place.

records.name: Oasi - Lungadige (Est)
records.recommendation: Retain as broad named east-bank riverside entry; exact trail unknown
records.location: Original label says Lungadige East/Est, along eastern Adige bank at Verona. Exact stretch/bridge and entrance remain unknown. No fabricated coordinates should be generated. West-bank Oasi–Lungadige Ovest remains a separately named listing.

recency_evidence.detail: Person says they will go in an hour, not that they saw or met people.
West/Ovest area reportedly cleared of vegetation; cannot transfer closure/activity claim to Est.

records.access: Riverside footpaths potentially affected by flooding/maintenance; no independently confirmed access point and no permission to enter private/bank-protected zones.
records.duplicate_review: Explicit Est vs Ovest source distinctions; do not merge or apply west closures to east without matching coordinates.
corrections: Preserve general reference, without point coordinates.
Mark 2026 discussion as intent rather than witnessed cruising.
No basis to label East obsolete because West solarium was cleared.

records.name: Zona Industriale - Ca' di Mazze
records.recommendation: Retain as named Via Ca' di Mazze industrial road, with no assumed exact pull-in
records.location: Via Ca' di Mazze is independently mapped in southern Verona's Palazzina industrial district. A named road suffices under owner general-area rule, though no unique private lot/parking space is identified.

recency_evidence.detail: Reply asks original author of an older vehicle encounter whether he returned; date of encounter unknown, not a 2026 reported sex encounter.

records.access: Commercial-industrial road and possible restricted private premises; roadside/public-road access should not imply access to private lots.
records.duplicate_review: Gays-Cruising original Palazzina entry itself separately lists Zona Industriale–Ca' di Mazze 0.2 km away. They are possible aliases/overlapping zones, NOT confirmed identical spots; do not auto-merge. Original Palazzina mentions a dirt pull-in after a roundabout, but source has not tied Ca' di Mazze to exactly that spot.
corrections: Existing copy says nearby Palazzina 'may describe same street section'; keep this only as possible, not proven.
Preserve separate listing pending actual map match.
Do not assign dated activity to undated older sexual encounter.

records.name: Centro Commerciale Verona Uno
records.recommendation: Retain with distinct positive and negative anonymous first-person accounts; no asserted busy period
records.location: Galleria VeronaUno on Via Monte Cristallo, San Giovanni Lupatoto (outside Verona municipality). Saved 45.394698,11.016658 is plausible mall locator. Source doesn't establish specific restroom bank as a current meeting area.

recency_evidence.detail: User claimed an encounter; independent corroboration absent.
Poster reported checking both toilet areas on 2026-04-28, seeing no one; this is negative evidence about one visit, not general permanent inactivity.

records.access: Official VeronaUno info lists centre 09:00–20:30 daily, hypermarket 08:30–20:30 and food court 09:00–20:30; the site lists urban bus line 22 and interurban 144. Toilet hours/approval cannot be inferred from centre hours.
records.duplicate_review: This physical mall is listed separately from a named Verona city/industrial estate and from Verona's Adigeo mall.
corrections: Existing evidence accurately records both conflicting 2026 experiences, and city correction to San Giovanni Lupatoto.
Improve practical directions to official bus stops only if source-linked, without asserting toilet access.
Never treat mall toilets as a designated cruising facility.

records.name: Zaķusala
records.recommendation: Retain named island with construction-access caveat and merge-risk check (not automatic merge)
records.location: Zaķusala island in Daugava, Riga; stored 56.93139,24.12222 is general island locator rather than exact cruising point. Source misspellings 'Za?usala', 'Zakjusala' map to Latvian Zaķusala; island includes operational TV transmitter grounds, which are distinct private/restricted infrastructure.
records.access: LVRTC signed >€38m tower-renovation contract September 10, 2026; announced work starting within months and estimated three years; tower was last open to public May 2019, projected reopening in 2029. These facts concern the tower site and must NOT imply entire island or unrelated cruising spot closed.
records.duplicate_review: Original directory has separately named candidate index 448 ('Zakjusala Natural area'); likely name/encoding collision for same island, but exact map entries must be compared before one listing is treated as duplicate.
corrections: Use correct Latvian 'Zaķusala'; keep spelling aliases for search.
Mark both duplicate candidates as likely same island without silently merging source evidence.
Don't imply that a 2026 construction contract proves park paths or island itself are inaccessible.

records.name: Galeria Metropolia
records.recommendation: Retain recently discussed commercial mall without implying first-person 2026 encounters
records.location: Galeria Metropolia at ul. płk. Jana Kilińskiego 4 in Gdańsk Wrzeszcz; original Gays-Cruising listing identifies a customer WC next to Affidea. Official mall AFFIDEA DIRECTORY says diagnostic centre is on level 1, which narrows a landmark, but restroom location on that floor is NOT confirmed. Saved 54.38278,18.60524 is general mall locator.

recency_evidence.detail: Poster says there until 17:00; does not report an encounter.

records.access: Mall official hours Monday–Saturday 10:00–21:00, Sunday 10:00–20:00. Official site places Affidea on level 1 with clinic Mon–Fri 08:00–20:00; clinic hours and retail hours do not establish access to any alleged WC or sexual approval.
records.duplicate_review: Nearby Manhattan Shopping Center is explicitly a separately named mall with its own source listing approx 0.6 km away; not a duplicate of Galeria Metropolia.
corrections: Useful new location clue: Affidea clinic currently level 1. Explicitly do not claim an adjacent WC confirmed there.
A 2026 on-site statement is NOT a witnessed cruising event; neither is current web check-in count.
Retail/clinic operating times must not be presented as cruising peaks.

high_value_findings: VeronaUno conflicting positive and negative physical reports from March/April 2026 must both be retained
Zaķusala TV tower redevelopment: tower restricted but whole island cannot be declared closed
Galeria Metropolia Affidea operator is on level 1, actual WC not confirmed
Ca di Mazze vs Palazzina 0.2 km: no proven duplicate
Lungadige east-bank not affected by unrelated west-bank clearing report
